purpose: Physically validate the shipped P7D/P7E promotion path through the normal agent-loop using only an explicit caller-owned Pulsar document context. The physical task must not inject visualFallbackContracts. runTask must materialize the bounded UTF-8 contract from {kind:pulsar-document, documentPath}, preserve a semantic-only planner, encounter structured NO_SEMANTIC_TARGET before local Vision selection, verify the exact caller-derived window-title surface, deliver CLICK_POSTED, and report VERIFIED_SUCCESS only after an independent exact UTF-16 LE post-action observation.
